proposal.hypothesis: Replacing tanh with a clamped exp2 sigmoid identity and reusing each loaded bias for 4 rows per thread reduces transcendental and parameter-load work, lowering latency on the 64x257 shape.
One 256-thread group per row, with thread 0 also handling column 256, avoids division/modulo and redundant threads while keeping coalesced access for the 64x257 shape.
